name: Agent Awake, Display Off
description: Keeps the computer from suspending while it should stay awake, while letting the display turn off. Click the status item to cycle On / Agent / Off, or set the mode in Settings.

settings.title: Keep awake mode
settings.description: On: always hold a sleep inhibitor. Agent: only while an agent is working. Off: let the computer sleep normally. The display can turn off in every mode.
